title: Associate in Biomedical Informatics
bio: Research William Feng graduated from Rutgers University in 2023 with a double major in biotechnology and computer science. During his time as an undergraduate student, he worked with Dr. Chang S. Chan investigating the impacts of TP53 mutations on alternative splicing and overall pathogenicity. He is currently an Associate Computational Biologist at the Park Lab, continuing his work on cancer genomics.
